newsitem.title: UK: Some UK economists say interest rate rise needed.
newsitem.headline: Some UK economists say interest rate rise needed.

text.p: Some British economists predict interest rates will need to rise as high as eight percent after the May 1 general election to head off inflationary pressures, The Times reported on Monday.

The newspaper said a report by Lehman Brothers, to be published later this week, argued official figures had been underestimating recent growth and that in reality the economy had been growing at above four percent over the past three quarters.
The report concluded interest rates, now standing at six percent, would "certainly" need to rise to 7.5 percent and "probably" to eight percent to slow the economy, The Times said.

It quoted Institute of Management director-general Roger Young as saying economic confidence was turning into over-confidence and that there were clear signs inflation was about to "raise its ugly head".
